'''Kavia Slen''' was a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
